sql: SELECT s.student_id, s.full_name, s.cgpa, f.txn_id, f.component, f.amount_due, f.amount_paid, (f.amount_due - f.amount_paid) AS outstanding_balance, f.due_date, f.status FROM students AS s JOIN fee_ledger AS f ON s.student_id = f.student_id WHERE s.student_id = 'S2025CS003' AND f.status = 'overdue' ORDER BY f.due_date LIMIT 200
